info.title: E-Pharmacy API
info.description: Authenticated administration API. Overall counters and 30-day statistics are separate. Unknown historical values use null with completeness metadata. New monetary values use EUR; legacy BDT is preserved without conversion. Unknown request body/query fields are rejected. JSON bodies have a 100 KB limit after decompression; invalid bodies return 400, oversized bodies 413, and unsupported charset/content encoding 415. The custom decimal128 format requires an exact BSON Decimal128 value; validators must enable that format in addition to the lexical pattern.
